newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL NOON RUBBER LOWER IN SLOW DEALING.
newsitem.headline: KL NOON RUBBER LOWER IN SLOW DEALING.

text.p: The Kuala Lumpur rubber market was weaker at midday with buyers continuing to be sidelined amid uncertainty about the currency movements.
Dealers said the market was inactive with little enquiries from the Far East and Europe seen.
"The market was concerned about the currency movements and Thai news on stocks," a dealer said. "
Sucharit Promedj, an advisor to Thailand's agriculture ministry, said on Wednesday the government had no plans to dump its stocks, estimated at 70,000 tonnes, any time soon.
At noon, September RSS1 buyer eased half a cent to 247 cents (94 U.S. cents) and September SMR 20 buyer was down 1.50 cents at 247.
Dealers offered SMR CV at 290 cents, SMR L at 276, SMR 5 at 255, SMR 10 at 246, SMR 20 at 245 and latex at 189 .
Malaysia-based shipping brokers quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $700 per 20-ft container, and $1,400 per 40-ft container.
